summary: Full-stack verification of VoltGrid pivot. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (39 pytest tests) covering OTP+JWT auth, wallet/top-up, charger lookup, complete session lifecycle with time-accelerated simulator, owner earnings/withdrawals, admin CRUD/telemetry/restart/status/faults/payouts and RBAC — 39/39 passing (2 skips on first parallel pass were ordering-related and passed on serial re-run). Frontend: Playwright e2e for all 3 roles — customer (demo login + OTP, wallet top-up, IND000001 lookup, start -> live metrics growing -> stop -> history, theme toggle, notifications), owner console (Overview/Chargers/Earnings, withdraw dialog), admin console (Overview KPIs+pie, charger restart/status select, add charger, add owner, wallet adjust, faults, payouts approve) and customer->/admin RBAC redirect. All flows worked; no blocking bugs.

minor.issue: Accounting mismatch when wallet is short: customer is debited min(cost, balance) but the session cost, owner 90% credit and admin revenue/commission all use the FULL cost. In testing a ₹480 session was billed against a smaller wallet, so owner/company were credited money never collected.
No energy/cost cap tied to wallet balance and no auto-stop; a customer with ₹100 can keep a session running until the 32 kWh sim cap (₹480+) and simply not pay the excess.

charger_id is derived from count_documents ({count+1}) — non-atomic and will produce duplicate IDs if a charger is ever deleted or on concurrent creates. Use a counter collection or uuid-derived sequence.
No rate limiting and OTP is not stored/validated per phone (fixed demo code accepted for any phone) — acceptable for demo, but note it also means any phone auto-creates an account with no throttle.
owner_earnings_window iterates every completed session in Python instead of a Mongo date-range/aggregation query; will not scale.

ui_bugs.issue: KPI cards render ₹0 / 0 for ~1s before the /api/admin/summary response arrives (no loading skeleton), which momentarily looks like an empty network

ui_bugs.component: Dialogs (add charger / add owner / adjust / scan)
ui_bugs.issue: Radix console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on DialogContent (a11y)

issues: Inactive nav labels (Overview/Chargers/Network/Faults) are light gray on white — borderline contrast vs the active item
Large empty area below content on 1920x1080 — cards do not fill the grid; consider a denser layout or recent-activity panel

action_items: Fix stop-session accounting: bill only what is collected (or block/auto-stop when balance is exhausted) so owner 90% + company 10% match actual collected revenue
Add wallet-based session cap / auto-stop in the simulator
Replace count-based charger_id generation with an atomic sequence
Add loading skeletons to admin/owner KPI cards; add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to dialogs
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stop_session: `charge = min(cost, bal)` silently under-collects while crediting owner/company on full cost — creates unbacked payouts.
compute_live caps energy at 32 kWh but never checks the customer's remaining balance, so a session can accrue cost far beyond wallet funds.
create_charger id from count_documents is not collision-safe.
All routes exclude _id correctly and all responses are Pydantic/dict-safe; env usage (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) is correct with no hardcoded URLs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (3 roles, all tabs/dialogs)
